title: Restore missing canonical backend routes through the HTTPS edge
purpose: Correct audit finding 3: the central edge currently omits registered Promo and staff routes, breaking canonical same-origin flows.
success_outcome: Every named missing route reaches its existing backend handler through real Caddy with auth/CSRF and headers preserved; realtime dispatch and upload/realtime body caps remain unchanged.

gates.name: Current Caddy configuration validation
gates.command: docker run --rm --network none -v "$PWD/deploy/Caddyfile:/etc/caddy/Caddyfile:ro" caddy:2.10.0-alpine caddy validate --config /etc/caddy/Caddyfile --adapter caddyfile

gates.name: Live isolated edge and central-shell regression
gates.command: uv run --locked --env-file .env.local python -m pytest tests/promo/test_public_edge_routes.py tests/client/test_central_shell.py

anti_goals: Do not change backend handlers, provider authorization/domain state, API shapes, staff UI, realtime inference/admission or model readiness.
Do not introduce catch-all /api/* forwarding, prefix stripping, exposed internal stores, a second public origin or frontend route aliases.
Do not run deployment, production smoke, Calibration calculations/apply/promotion, retention cleanup or inventory destructive actions. Finding 10 packaged smoke remains separate.

forbidden_scope: Application runtime source, other test files, model assets, package dependencies and migrations
compose.yaml, VPS/FRP Caddy configuration and production infrastructure
stop_conditions: The named existing canonical handlers cannot be tested through their published contracts without runtime repair outside the boundary.
Live Caddy proof cannot be isolated to disposable resources/current source, or auth/caps require a changed accepted public contract.

constraints: Primary feature owner is promo/FT-005 for its same-origin display APIs; this is shared edge transport wiring only. Serving_control, inventory and diagnostics retain their registered handlers and business authority under the existing graph.

Restore these exact route groups to backend:8000 without stripping paths: /api/promo/*, /api/serving/spas/*/active-visit-date, /api/diagnostics/retention, /staff/search-settings, /staff/photo-inventory, /staff/calibrations, /staff/calibrations/* and /staff/diagnostics-retention. One named matcher/handle is sufficient; reuse existing proxy header behavior.

Keep /api/realtime/attempts and /api/realtime/attempts/*/client-timing on realtime:8002 with 20MiB cap, upload Content-Length prechecks and /api/inventory/photos 11MiB cap, existing phone/client/staff paths and X-Forwarded-For behavior. /api/promo/* maps the existing GET config/media and PUT display routes.

Use the pinned caddy:2.10.0-alpine image and current deploy/Caddyfile in a unique disposable Docker network/test harness, with loopback-only HTTPS access and task-owned temp TLS/data files. Any fixture substitution is limited to listen/upstream addresses for isolated ports; keep the actual matchers/order/header and cap directives.

Drive real current-source backend route registration and auth using task-owned disposable PostgreSQL users, display tokens, SPA, Attempt/session and synthetic preview fixtures. Backend alone does not need selected-model warmup. A deterministic private object-store test adapter may supply preview bytes; a clearly instrumented realtime upstream may prove dispatch/caps without claiming model inference or production readiness.

Read existing fixture conventions and tests/disposable_postgresql.py before setup. No operator/default row or object is changed. Teardown always stops only owned containers/processes, removes their network/TLS directories and drops only the generated database; no global Docker cleanup.

Initial RED uses actual requests through current Caddy proving routes are not forwarded; GREEN repeats equivalent route/auth probes after edit. Static config checks alone are not closure. Verify and per-task red-verify precede explicit owner closure.
invariants: Canonical paths retain their full prefix and existing owner authorization; edge adds no auth bypass or backend business decision.
Realtime dispatch and both existing byte caps remain intact; internal stores stay unreachable from the public edge.
No underlying domain outcome or completed baseline task is re-owned by this routing correction.
verification_targets: FT-005-AC-006: through live isolated Caddy, valid display token receives GET /api/promo/display/config 200, authorized GET /api/promo/media/{media_ref} 200 image/jpeg and PUT /api/promo/sessions/{session_id}/display 200 with the stored display result. Missing/invalid token remains 401; unknown/foreign media remains 404; no-store and Authorization forwarding hold.

FT-005-AC-006 / REQ-SEC-001: each added staff route group reaches the real backend. Without session expect 401; authorized role reads yield 200 or canonical resource-not-found responses; denied roles yield 403. Exercise GET/PUT active-visit-date and one non-destructive invalid Calibration POST with valid identity but missing CSRF to prove 403 without mutation; do not run calculations/apply/delete. Inventory page admits all staff roles. Search settings and GET/PUT active-visit-date are operator-only; developer and photographer receive 403. Retention allows operator/developer and rejects photographer with 403; Calibration is developer-only.

FT-005-AC-006: instrumented upstream observations prove realtime requests and client-timing reach the realtime service, /api/promo goes to backend, prefixes are preserved, missing-length/over-cap uploads are rejected before backend receipt, and realtime body above 20,971,520 bytes yields 413. Include a valid small request to each dispatch path; check existing phone/client routes and internal-service privacy as regression.

Persist task-owned known fixtures only; compare authorized ack/active-date mutation via owner projections in the fixture DB, preserve unrelated rows and prove safe teardown. Record status/content-type/cache headers and sanitized upstream route counters; exclude credentials, result payloads and raw media from logs/artifacts.
evidence_required: FT-005-AC-006 RED: current real Caddy fails to forward the listed canonical routes despite registered handlers; GREEN: equivalent authenticated config/media/ack and staff route-group requests reach their existing owners, unauthorized/role/CSRF cases retain canonical rejections, realtime dispatch and upload/realtime caps are preserved; decisive comparison: HTTP status/header matrix, sanitized upstream observations and task-owned state before/after permitted mutations; artifact: isolated live-Caddy regression transcript and teardown record under .tasks/TASK-115-T3-FT-005-W4/.
